intended_object: The adjunction between n-truncation of simplicial sets, sSet → sSet_{≤n}, and the n-coskeleton functor sSet_{≤n} → sSet (right Kan extension along the inclusion Δ_{≤n} ↪ Δ), with truncation as the left adjoint. Taken from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body is just the general Mathlib adjunction `SimplicialObject.coskAdj n` (truncation ⊣ coskeleton, valid for simplicial objects in any category with the right limits), applied to the category of types, i.e. to simplicial sets. The direction is right: truncation is the left adjoint and the coskeleton, being a right Kan extension, is the right adjoint. The definition does not re-implement anything in a special setting; it only makes the general result available under the `SSet` names, as Mathlib routinely does in this file (`SSet.cosk`, `SSet.Truncated.cosk`). The adjunction for simplicial sets is a standard object in its own right, and the general version is already in Mathlib, so this specialization is not too narrow.
